clusters.name: rebaseline
clusters.executionModeRationale: Pure measurement (writes job-dir artifacts only); gates every downstream story by establishing which clusters persist unloaded. Must complete before any fix.

clusters.name: unit-fixes
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-001/US-002/US-003 touch fully disjoint test files with no shared config, so they can run in parallel once Story 0 establishes ground truth.

clusters.name: config-and-timing
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-004 (unit testTimeout) and US-005 (integration project gating) BOTH edit packages/happy-cli/vitest.config.ts, so they are bundled into one serialized story-pair to avoid a conflicting edit; run after the unit fixes so the gate signal is clean.

clusters.name: acceptance-closeout
clusters.executionModeRationale: Final green verification and skip-list documentation require all prior clusters landed; it owns AGENTS.md exclusively.
